entities.name: Direction du renseignement militaire
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary:
The Directorate of Military Intelligence is a French intelligence agency that has the task of collecting and centralizing military intelligence information for the French Armed Forces. Created in 1992, after Gulf War, its role is similar to that of the DIA, the DI or the GRU. It was formed by merging the Army Intelligence
Bureau and the Military Intelligence Exploitation Centre. The DRM reports directly to the Chief of Staff and to the President of France, supreme commander of the French military.
